retention.note: Blobs are NOT tracked in git; this manifest is. A fitted estimator embeds training data (and tree split thresholds, which cannot be scrubbed), so committing one would place raw Treasury figures permanently in every clone. The tracked SHA-256 still proves which estimator produced a published number and detects substitution. This deliberately diverges from the retention rule for forecast.csv, which IS the claim and must survive a clone; an estimator only re-derives it.
